scope:
Offline DNS transaction matching contracts (RFC 5452 and RFC 4343).

Endpoint metadata is supplied by the fixture; this is not socket integration.
limits: Offline metadata/packet comparisons only; transport must provide actual selected and observed endpoints, including IPv6 scope.
No source-port/ID random generation, socket integration, retry engine, cryptographic authentication, record trust, alias traversal or caching is implemented here.
The single-question matcher requires one complete matching question before returning Truncated; it does not interpret incomplete record sections.
Matched means correlated and structurally parsed, not a successful DNS response code or permission to trust/cache every record. Header flags and error response codes remain available to later policy.
